content: Hi how can i assist you today
The bus arrival board shows numbers that match dates I’m thinking about. It feels like a signal.
Boards cycle route numbers and minutes. Which numbers matched—route IDs, countdown times, or both?
Route 21 and a 14-minute wait, same as a birthday 2/14.
Route IDs and common minute values create many overlaps with dates. A quick photo of the board across a few cycles can show how often such pairs appear even without the thought in mind.
I’ll take a few photos this week.
Comparing those against unrelated dates should give a sense of how frequent the coincidences are.
